title: Tadalafil
description: How tadalafil relaxes blood vessels, its established uses and the mixed findings in Raynaud studies.
scope: Tadalafil in erectile dysfunction, benign prostatic hyperplasia, pulmonary arterial hypertension and secondary Raynaud phenomenon.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Tadalafil inhibits PDE5, an enzyme involved in smooth-muscle relaxation. It is used for erectile dysfunction, urinary symptoms from benign prostatic hyperplasia and, under a separate indication, pulmonary arterial hypertension. Pulmonary arterial hypertension is an established tadalafil indication. Research in secondary Raynaud phenomenon is mixed: one small add-on trial reported improved attacks and ulcer healing, while another found no symptom advantage over placebo.

questions.question: Does tadalafil improve Raynaud symptoms?
questions.answer: The 2010 study found fewer and shorter attacks with tadalafil added to existing vasodilators. The 2009 trial found no difference in attacks or condition score. The populations and treatment schedules differed.

sentences.text: The 2010 study found fewer and shorter attacks with tadalafil added to existing vasodilators. The 2009 trial found no difference in attacks or condition score. The populations and treatment schedules differed.

questions.question: What happened to digital ulcers?
questions.answer: In the 2010 trial, 24 of 24 existing digital lesions healed during tadalafil treatment versus 3 of 13 during placebo. These are lesion counts, not numbers of patients.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Headache, indigestion, back pain, muscle pain and flushing are common adverse effects. Rare serious concerns include prolonged erection and sudden vision or hearing loss. Its vasodilator action can cause symptomatic low blood pressure; pulmonary veno-occlusive disease can worsen with pulmonary vasodilators.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Organic nitrates, riociguat and a previous serious hypersensitivity reaction are contraindications.

sentences.text: Organic nitrates, riociguat and a previous serious hypersensitivity reaction are contraindications.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Alpha-blockers, antihypertensives and substantial alcohol intake can add to blood-pressure lowering. Strong CYP3A inhibitors increase tadalafil exposure; inducers can reduce it.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The Raynaud trials tested 20 mg daily for four weeks or 20 mg on alternate days for six weeks; neither establishes a universal Raynaud regimen. The labeled adult pulmonary-hypertension regimen is 40 mg once daily, with kidney, liver and interaction restrictions.

questions.question: Does this schedule establish a dose for every investigated use?

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: The negative Raynaud crossover trial had 39 evaluable participants. In the positive trial, 24 of 25 recruited participants completed follow-up; new digital ulcers numbered one during tadalafil and 13 during placebo.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: Cialis and Adcirca contain tadalafil but have different labeled indications and regimens. Product strength and indication therefore matter when interpreting a study schedule.

sentences.text: Cialis and Adcirca contain tadalafil but have different labeled indications and regimens. Product strength and indication therefore matter when interpreting a study schedule.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: US labeling covers erectile dysfunction and benign prostatic hyperplasia for Cialis, and WHO group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension for Adcirca. Raynaud phenomenon is outside these labeled indications.

sentences.text: US labeling covers erectile dysfunction and benign prostatic hyperplasia for Cialis, and WHO group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension for Adcirca. Raynaud phenomenon is outside these labeled indications.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: Both Raynaud trials used crossover designs and small samples. Their conflicting results leave uncertainty about which patients benefit from tadalafil and under which background treatment. The negative Raynaud crossover trial had 39 evaluable participants. In the positive trial, 24 of 25 recruited participants completed follow-up; new digital ulcers numbered one during tadalafil and 13 during placebo.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: Sildenafil is another PDE5 inhibitor. Its studies provide a related comparison, while tadalafil has its own clinical trial results.

faqs.question: Is every type of pulmonary hypertension a tadalafil indication?
faqs.answer: No. The Adcirca indication specifies pulmonary arterial hypertension in WHO group 1.

sentences.text: No. The Adcirca indication specifies pulmonary arterial hypertension in WHO group 1.

faqs.question: Why are nitrates a major interaction?
faqs.answer: Combining nitrates with tadalafil can produce a dangerous fall in blood pressure. The label specifies at least 48 hours after the last tadalafil dose before nitrate consideration in a life-threatening emergency, with close medical monitoring.
